candidates.tagline: Ferrari hired the iPhone designer, spent €550K per car, and this is what they got
candidates.story: On Oct 22, 2026, McLaren P1 designer Frank Stephenson wrote in Top Gear that the Ferrari Luce — a €550,000 EV with exterior shaped with Jony Ive's studio LoveFrom — is 'a well-executed mistake in automotive design,' while Pininfarina's former design chief called it 'a soulless object' and ex-CEO Luca di Montezemolo declared it 'destruction of a myth.'
candidates.why_funny: Ferrari paid the designer of the iPhone to create its dream first EV, priced it at half a million euros, and professional car designers are making YouTube redesigns to fix it.
candidates.alt: A matte grey 2027 Ferrari Luce electric liftback on display at a concours event, its small yellow prancing-horse badge the only obvious Ferrari cue on an otherwise generic-looking body

candidates.tagline: JustEat's AI read 'soda bread' and put a full fry-up in a pint of Coke
candidates.story: On Oct 21–23, 2026, Just Eat apologized and paused a trial of AI-generated menu photos after they went viral: the AI placed fried eggs and sausages inside a cola glass (apparently reading 'soda bread' as soda), produced garlic bread shaped like a plane, and a jacket potato rendered as a puffer jacket — every image was manually reviewed by a human before going live.
candidates.why_funny: Just Eat deployed AI to make menus look more appetising, had a human check every image, and still managed to publish a photo of a Northern Irish breakfast floating in a pint of fizzy drink as the recommended image for a soda bread sandwich.
candidates.alt: AI-generated Just Eat menu photo showing a fried egg and two sausages floating inside a tall glass of dark cola with ice, with bread visible on a plate in the background
